# Overrides for `uv pip compile` (see the header of semgrep.txt).
# semgrep pins mcp==1.29.0, which is affected by GHSA-84m7-p3x7-pcfv (fixed in 1.30.0).
# Delete this line once semgrep's own requirement allows mcp>=1.30.0.
mcp>=1.30.0,<2
# semgrep pins the OpenTelemetry 1.37.0 / 0.58b0 family. opentelemetry-api <= 1.45.0 is
# affected by GHSA-xcq7-p3pf-p88h (fixed in 1.45.1) and <= 1.45.1 by GHSA-mf5v-w3w3-f6cg
# (fixed in 1.45.2). The family moves together.
# Delete these lines once semgrep's own requirements allow opentelemetry-api>=1.45.2.
opentelemetry-api>=1.45.2,<2
opentelemetry-sdk>=1.45.2,<2
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http>=1.45.2,<2
opentelemetry-instrumentation-requests>=0.66b1
opentelemetry-instrumentation-threading>=0.66b1

# semgrep pins wcmatch~=8.3 (still true of 1.187.0), but wcmatch <= 11.1 is affected by
# GHSA-53pm-wgxf-c6qf (polynomial-time ReDoS on multi-star patterns).
# Drop this override once a semgrep release allows wcmatch >= 11.2.
wcmatch>=11.2
